column6: What is needed is positive feedback overstated as the sole requirement (bistability can also arise without explicit feedback, e.g. multisite phosphorylation with enzyme sequestration); softened to "usual ingredient"
Older Core Idea: "Most biological networks are scale-free" is an overstatement (contested; Broido and Clauset 2019 find strong scale-free structure rare); not edited, out of scope
Exercise fails as worked: cyclin degraded by APC/C at a fixed rate gives a steady state, not an oscillator; APC/C must be activated by CDK1 (negative feedback). Added that
Not wrong but underspecified: added that the classic Goodwin form needs a Hill coefficient above about 8 (matches Questions item 0), so the sweep actually reaches the Hopf point
period depends mostly on post-translational steps overstated; softened to "is often most sensitive to"

Exercise fails as worked: a target-limited TIV/effector model without target-cell production always clears, so there is no clearance/persistence line to find; changed to watching peak viral load and time to clearance
Correction overstated: ODEs can give an average encounter rate; softened so only search paths, contacts and geometry need spatial/agent models

Exercise likely fails as worked: single deletions in the E. coli core model rarely give growth coupling; changed to deletions alone and in combination. Older Core Idea: OptForce uses measured fluxes, not kinetic constraints; OptKnock coupling holds at maximal growth only (not edited)
Exercise fails as worked: cells had no division rule, so no tumor shape can form; added that the oxygen signal decides division
Steps muddled: a Hill function of an external input plotted against P gives one flat line; made it a Hill function of P (self-activation) and moved bistability to raising the Hill coefficient
evolvability follows from it stated as a rule; softened to "can follow"
sudden bursts of transcription names the wrong phenomenon (bursting); the known velocity failure is a mid-process rise in transcription rate (transcriptional boost); reworded

Exercise fails as worked with common tools: an orthonormal null-space basis (e.g. scipy) mixes routes and is unreadable; specified a rational basis (e.g. SymPy). Older Core Idea: null space alone is not "thermodynamically" feasible; bounds are needed (not edited)
Style only: "take over over many generations" reworded
